=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:108-115 (also scripts/cs_investigate.sh:93-105) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: Both the "Validate inputs" Python check and the scripts/cs_investigate.sh check reduce a hub URL on port 443 to the bare host, but `CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS` entries are only lowercased and then compared as written, so an entry `hub.example:443` never matches `https://hub.example` or `https://hub.example:443`.
  WHY: A caller who sets `CS_HUB_ALLOWED_HOSTS=hub.example:443` (a natural reading of the documented "`host` or `host:port`" format) fails "Validate inputs" with exit 1 on every run, so no verdict is produced and the CS hub escalates every ticket; this fails closed and is not a security hole (every source rated it NIT, mapped here to low; confidence ranged from 3 to 5).
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml:61-67 (also line 225; scripts/cs_investigate.sh:280-285; agents.d/9440-cs-investigate.md) | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The workflow comment and the agents fragment say `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY: 'always'` runs codex for "every"/"any" Claude failure, but `claude_run_selected` falls back only on exit 75. A Claude timeout (124/137) or crash (1, or any other non-zero status) is mapped by scripts/cs_investigate.sh to `invalid_verdict` (`engine_timeout`/`engine_failed`) without trying codex.
  WHY: The documented contract and the actual behaviour disagree, which misleads operators who expect a codex retry. The reviewers disagree on detail: minimax says broker-refused (76) also skips codex, while sonnet and glm say no-credential and refused-token paths do become 75 under `always`. Every source rated it NIT, mapped here to low.
- scripts/cs_investigate.sh:241 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: Integer parsing for `engine_timeout` and `run_deadline` does not force base 10, so leading-zero values are read as octal.
  WHY: `0900` causes an arithmetic error and other zero-padded values give wrong numbers. This is possibly the same root cause as the next entry, but the line ranges do not overlap, so it is not merged (source rated NIT, mapped to low).
- scripts/cs_investigate.sh:224-227,272 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The `^[0-9]{1,5}$` regex accepts leading zeros, so `CS_RUN_DEADLINE_SECS=0900` makes `$((run_deadline - SECONDS))` fail with "value too great for base" and leaves `round_budget` empty.
  WHY: Both deadline guards then error out and are silently skipped, so the run continues with no deadline cap. The workflow cannot reach this today because it sets neither variable. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same issue as a HARDENING_SUGGESTION (risk score 1), not as a finding. Source rated NIT, mapped to low.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml ("Validate inputs" Python check), with the same logic in scripts/cs_investigate.sh (`hub_key="${hub_host}"` / `[ "${allowed_host,,}" = "${hub_key}" ]`) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Port 443 is reduced to the bare host but allowlist entries are only lowercased, so `hub.example:443` never matches.
  WHY: "Validate inputs" exits 1 on every dispatch, the CS hub escalates every ticket, and this fails closed. Fix: strip a trailing `:443` from each entry, or document that port 443 must be written without a port.
- .github/workflows/cs_investigate.yml (env comment above `AI_ENGINE_FALLBACK_POLICY: 'always'`) and agents.d/9440-cs-investigate.md; scripts/ai_engine.sh `claude_run` lines 648-654 and `claude_run_selected` lines 790-793 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Only the unavailability paths become exit 75 and run codex. A timeout (124) or crash (1) becomes `invalid_verdict` with no codex attempt, contrary to "any Claude failure".
  WHY: The documentation misleads operators. Fix the wording to "Claude being unavailable (no credential, refused broker token, isolation unavailable, all accounts usage-limited or failed)".
- TASK COMPLETENESS: NONE. Every deliverable of #9440 is present, AD-1 option B is not a gap, CI reports `failed_count: 0`, and the pre-push gate failures do not map to a defect in the diff.
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: scripts/cs_investigate.sh `engine_timeout` / `run_deadline` parsing and `round_budget=$((run_deadline - SECONDS))`. Leading zeros cause an octal error or wrong value; normalise with `$((10#...))` (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
